bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - Award of Excellence  The newly launched Afternoon Tea at The Stafford London includes dainty finger sandwiches and delicious homemade sweet and savoury scones, accompanied by a selection of seasonal cakes and pastries, all served table-side from our bespoke, handcrafted trolley for an added sense of theatre and occasion. To accompany the sweets and savouries, choose from a fine choice of from Camellia’s Tea House, or for those wishing to celebrate in style, enjoy a chilled glass of Champagnes from the extensive wine list.  Located in the heart of historical St James's 5 Star Hotel, The Stafford London is a haven of calm tucked away from London's busy streets. Green Park Tube Station is a 2-minute walk away and close to excellent shopping, galleries and museums.  Afternoon tea is served between 12 – 5.30pm daily  * If you have any dietary preferences, please advise the venue a minimum of 24h prior to you booking. Requests outside this time period or on the day may not be accommodated due to availability of produce.
